method.browser: Playwright Chromium headed, ANGLE Metal Apple M3 Pro
method.settings: localStorage cleared before each sample; original reference save loaded; default graphics; toolbar expanded
method.steadyState: Waves disabled, original food/materials/population preserved; saved camera; 1800 ms warmup; 3500 ms complete render-frame window; three rounds with reversed order in round two
method.cpuProfile: Separate day-running sample, 500 microsecond CDP sampling interval
method.focus: Separate instrumented day sample; then 30 seconds running and 12 seconds of approach/combat
method.rubbleAB: Six fresh loads, waves disabled; 4000 ms windows after 1800 ms warmup; only experiment is an in-browser Rubble.blocks wrapper returning false when count() is zero; no source edit
method.wave: Original rules; debug advance to first destruction, then 20 seconds at normal speed. Fast-forward CPU duration is not an actual gameplay frame.

steadyState.scenario: Saved camera, reload before each sample, waves disabled, otherwise original resources and rules
